title: Consequences Archive
description: Consequences Archive includes archived structure inventories that represent earlier versions of the inventory in the calibration phase. The NSI year should reflect the year (version) of the NSI, and the price level year should reflect the price level year if prices are indexed. The yyyymmdd represents the date the inventory was archived. The README naming convention is <modeling-unit>-nsiyyyy-pricelevelyyyy-yyyymmmdd.gpkg.
